details.report:
Committed F4 as forward commit 147241f. Doctor activation now resolves manifest/receipt/verdict/disposition bytes with `git show <full-target>:<canonical-path>` before model access, rejects noncanonical/out-of-docket paths, wrong targets, duplicate sources, inaccessible/malformed bytes, and caller assertion mismatches, then derives the admitted payload, byte length, digest, and sealed identity from committed bytes. Git and tracker metadata now pass closed normalized contracts; StatsLines continue through the strengthened public validator. Existing actual-bite joins therefore bind resolver-derived identities, while the model remains limited to admitted IDs and the two Doctor tools.

Added frozen-target greens and fabricated-receipt, byte mismatch, escape/alias, duplicate, wrong-target, malformed/inaccessible, and metadata-shape reds. Preserved F5, R1/L1, tool narrowing, audit, and packaging behavior; did not modify F1-F3 or Soul.

Verification: focused Doctor/StatsLine suite 15/15; typecheck passed; isolated-HOME full suite 348 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped; recorder artifacts regenerated; package dry-run included the resolver; cold tarball install passed; full package lifecycle passed. An initial full run exposed that the repository’s isolated pack helper copies only tracked/staged inputs, so the new resolver was absent while untracked; staging the authorized file corrected the package input and the complete full run then passed. `git diff HEAD^ --check` passed and the worktree is clean.
